_about: Search-engine angle. Needs BRAVE_API_KEY or SERPER_API_KEY as a repo secret (both have free tiers). Without one, a small DuckDuckGo fallback runs. 'daily' queries run every day; site lookups for boards with search:true run weekly, several sites per query. Results that point to a company job board also add that board to daily tracking.
daily: site:jobs.ashbyhq.com "product designer" (Europe OR EMEA OR remote)
site:job-boards.greenhouse.io "product designer" (Europe OR EMEA OR remote)
site:jobs.lever.co "product designer" (Europe OR EMEA OR remote)
